Response A runs about 133 words, clearly over the 120-word limit. Response B lands at roughly 120 words, depending on how list markers and symbols are counted. That makes it essentially compliant.

Both are accurate and cover the same core ideas: chaining, open addressing, load factor, average O(1) versus worst-case O(n), and resizing. A adds the Java HashMap tree detail and specific thresholds. B adds the useful point that resizing keeps insertion at amortized O(1).
